name: Lone Schwarzschild black hole with a thin disk

metadata.source: Constructed scene for the black-hole renderer (docs/rendering.md, Black hole): a non-rotating hole of 4.3e6 Msun, about the mass of Sgr A* (4.297e6 Msun, GRAVITY Collaboration 2022, A&A 657, L12), at rest at the origin. Its thin accretion disk is a rendering model (ISCO to 30 GM/c^2 in the plane normal to +z), not a body.
metadata.description: A single black hole. The image does not depend on the mass when lengths are measured in units of GM/c^2 (r_s = 2 GM/c^2 = 0.0849 AU here); the framing camera orbits it 12 degrees above the disk plane.
